name: leonybom-mods
description: Leo's mods for Claude Code: Clean View, Tools, Infobar and Prompt Upgrade.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: A calm, friendly view: hides tool rows and shows one simple checklist of the plan above the prompt.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Tools: one panel to switch model and effort, turn your mods on and off, and run quick actions.

plugins.name: infobar
plugins.description: Infobar: one line under the prompt with your model, effort, git branch, how full the chat is, usage limits and running agents.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Prompt Upgrade: turns a rough prompt into a great one in a pane, with a few quick questions, before anything is sent.
